round_verdicts.verdict: PARTIAL-DISAGREE — impl-20 remains supported; stored judge tally and read-only claim are inaccurate
round_verdicts.detail: Installed souji-vault-verify matches impl-20 and passes 35/35. The eight stored vfinal records resolve to seven impl-20 winner-named records and one NO-CLEAN-CANDIDATE (S60), not the report/lesson's 5/3 split; LOG.md separately says 4/8 dissented. S60's shared V6 failures are a fixture-root/path problem, not evidence of an impl-20 defect: a fresh /tmp V6 build verified both CRLF and LF rows using impl-20. Separately, S53's harness launched the real GUI through backtick command substitution and changed app-owned .obsidian metadata; the report's 'vault read-only throughout' statement is contradicted. This is a harness rail breach, not a verifier defect. The official Obsidian CLI requirement was withdrawn by the operator mid-round.
